plastics.name: Plastics
tips: Empty and quickly rinse bottles and containers.
Crush bottles to save space.
Food-soiled plastic that can't be cleaned goes to Landfill.

paper.name: Paper / Cardboard
tips: Keep it dry - wet or greasy paper can't be recycled.
Flatten cardboard boxes.
Paper cups and pizza boxes with grease usually go to Landfill.

glass.name: Glass
tips: Empty and rinse bottles and jars.
Remove metal caps and put them with Metal.
Broken glass: wrap it in newspaper and label it before disposal.

metal.name: Metal
tips: Empty and rinse cans and tins.
Crush cans to save space.
Spray cans and batteries are not regular metal; ask at the e-waste point.

compost.name: Compost (Wet waste)
tips: Remove plastic packaging, foil and cutlery first.
Drain liquids before throwing.
Leaf plates and used tissues can go here.

ewaste.name: E-Waste
tips: Never throw batteries in regular bins - they can cause fires.
Tape the terminals of lithium batteries.
Wipe personal data from phones and drives first.

landfill.name: Landfill (Reject)
tips: Use this only when an item fits no other category.
Wrap sanitary waste in paper before disposal.
Not sure? Clean recyclables are better than contaminated ones.
